name: GD Collab
description: Build levels together live: host a room in the editor, friends join with the code, and everyone's edits sync.

sync-interval.name: Sync Speed (seconds)
sync-interval.description: How often your edits are sent and others' edits are pulled in. Lower is faster but uses more internet.

check-updates.name: Check for Updates
check-updates.description: When GD starts, check for a new version of this mod and offer to install it.
